findings.title: Stale Pre-Vote round survives the node's own election win and makes the new Leader call elect()
findings.scenario: U2: stale Pre-Vote round outlives own election win
findings.summary: Engine::pre_elect starts a Pre-Vote round without dropping an active real candidate (the election tick does this for a timed-out Candidate; trigger().elect(true) does it on demand). If late real vote grants then make the node Leader, establish_leader/become_leader do not clear pre_candidate, the runtime filter matches only the probe leader id, and the quorum branch of handle_pre_vote_resp calls elect() on the established Leader. The node abandons the term it just won, becomes Candidate at term+1 while keeping its Leader object; in debug builds the next try_leader_handler hits debug_assert!(leader.vote >= state.vote) and RaftCore panics (reproduced on the real runtime: spec/output/repro-MC-1-new.log), in release builds the leader is demoted to a term+1 Candidate that followers holding its lease reject (spec/output/repro-MC-1-new-release.log). The same step violates the implementation-asserted LeaderObjectVoteNotBehind.

findings.title: A delayed Pre-Vote grant from an earlier round at the same probe reaches grant_by() for a node outside the current round's quorum set and panics RaftCore
findings.scenario: U2b/U3: cross-round Pre-Vote responses vs. membership change
findings.summary: Pre-Vote responses are correlated only by the probe leader id (term+1, self) (does_pre_candidate_vote_match), and every round started at an unchanged vote term reuses that probe. Candidate::new builds its progress over the frozen voters only (VecProgress::new(quorum_set, [], ..)), and grant_by() expect()s the target to be tracked. When a node is removed from the membership between two rounds, its delayed grant for the first round is delivered to the second round and grant_by() panics with 'target not in quorum set'. Model checking found it without crashes (leader starts a round, removes node 2 via joint/uniform changes, starts another round via trigger().elect(true), node 2's old grant arrives). Reproduced on the real runtime: spec/output/repro-D-4-new.log (3/3 runs, panic at proposer/candidate.rs:107).
